verdict.rationale: Replicate documents deploying your own custom models with Cog, its open-source packaging tool, and serving them with managed infrastructure (including model weights), autoscaling and scale-to-zero. It also supports fine-tuning open-source models on your own data, with fast-booting fine-tunes billed only for active time. However, the evidence does not explicitly describe uploading arbitrary pre-trained weight files or bringing your own LoRA adapters, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: explicit documentation of uploading your own LoRA adapters or raw weight files for serving, step-by-step Cog deployment detail, independent/hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters

citations.quote: you can deploy your own custom models using Cog, our open-source tool for packaging machine learning models
We handle API servers, dependencies, model weights, CUDA, GPUs, and batching.
For fast booting fine-tunes you'll only be billed for the time the model is active and processing your requests
Run and fine-tune open-source models. Deploy custom models at scale.
